Shadow Cloak

Item

Wondrous Item, Uncommon (requires attunement)

A thin, black cloak with a collar that rises up around the neck, it seems to absorb light around it, obfuscating the wearer slightly. The wearer is always considered Lightly Obscured, unless the Daylight spell or other radiant sources of light is shone upon them.
